title: Survival Harmony
description: This modpack doesn't add anything new; it simply refines existing game mechanics. It's designed to enhance the gameplay experience in the base game and make it more enjoyable.
body:
This modpack is designed not to change the core identity of Minecraft, but to refine and elevate it. It doesn’t introduce new items, dimensions, or mechanics; instead, it focuses on polishing the existing vanilla systems to make survival smoother, more engaging, and more enjoyable. Every feature is carefully chosen to enhance the natural flow of gameplay, ensuring that the experience remains faithful to the original while eliminating unnecessary frustrations. 

Mods included in the Modpack:
- Advancement Plaques
- AppleSkin
- Armor Hud
- Cherished Worlds
- CIT Resewn
- Dark Loading Screen
- Entity Culling
- Fabric API
- Forge Config API Port
- Iceberg
- Item Highlighter
- Jade 
- Jade Addons (Fabric)
- Just Enough Items (JEI)
- LambDynamicLights
- Pick Up Notifier
- Puzzles Lib
- Shulker Box Tooltip
- Sodium
- Sodium Extra
- Xaero's Minimap
  
Resource packs included in the Modpack:
- Icons
- Low On Fire
- Recolourful Containers GUI + HUD
- Visual: Armor Trims
